environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 6.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door with a Rules Engine configuration that appends response headers. The Rules Engine has a rule named 'sec-headers-all-routes' with condition 'If Request Protocol equals HTTPS' (always true for Front Door backend) and action 'Modify Response Header: Append' with header name 'Content-Security-Policy' and value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.reporting.internal; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'". Additionally, the App Service has a custom startup command that sets the ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT to 'Production' and the application's web.config includes an outbound rewrite rule that strips any existing CSP headers from the application response before Front Door appends its own (preventing header duplication). The Front Door WAF policy 'waf-reporting-prod' is in Detection mode only (not Block) for OWASP CRS rules, meaning it logs but does not block XSS patterns.

config.front_door: Azure Front Door with Rules Engine 'sec-headers-all-routes'
config.csp_value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.reporting.internal; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
config.web_config_outbound_rule: strips pre-existing CSP headers from app response
config.waf_policy: waf-reporting-prod in Detection mode (log only, no blocking)
